item.title: AAPL beats Q3 estimates on strong iPhone sales
item.description: Apple Inc (AAPL.O) reported third-quarter earnings that beat Wall Street estimates, driven by stronger-than-expected iPhone sales. CEO Tim Cook said "We are very pleased with our results." The company reported EPS of $1.55 vs $1.42 consensus.

item.title: MSFT cloud growth accelerates in Q1
item.description: Microsoft Corp (MSFT.O) reported first-quarter revenue above estimates, with Azure growth accelerating to 30%. CEO Satya Nadella said "We are seeing strong demand across our cloud portfolio."

item.title: Fed holds rates steady, signals one more hike
item.description: The Federal Reserve held interest rates steady at 5.25%-5.50% but signaled one more rate hike this year. Chair Jerome Powell said "Inflation remains above target."
